availabilityPolicy: Publish times must be ISO 8601 with explicit Z/UTC offset. Withdrawal is transactionally fenced against reservations. Times on a slot are immutable. Publishing an exactly matching withdrawn start/end reactivates its same ID; any changed time uses a new ID. Old cancelled bookings retain original times.
revisionPolicy: Only a student can revise their own latest needs_revision Evidence for the same booking. Upload captures the current reviewVersion server-side. Final submit rechecks that review and atomically commits a single successor; concurrent or stale revisions conflict. Earlier evidence bytes, review and identifiers remain immutable. Superseded evidence cannot be reviewed again. Counters count all versions, manual review is not academic credit.
localDatabaseMigration: Schema8 adds the persisted staff class catalog and extends existing calendar enrollment statuses and format/approval metadata. Existing users, meetings, enrollments, private Evidence files and revisions are preserved. Evidence upload/submission tables gain nullable class_id with exactly one appointment or class context. Before upgrading an older database, startup verifies a private SQLite VACUUM snapshot, migrates transactionally, validates foreign keys, and re-enables relationship enforcement. No accounts or courses are auto-seeded. Backup tooling validates supported schemas without implicit migration. Schema9 adds parent-bound admissions_student_setups and nullable calendar_enrollments.goal_id referencing the same student learning goal. Migration remains additive from schema8, with verified original backup and foreign-key validation.
accountSecurityPolicy: Password changes require the current password, per-account and per-IP rate limits, fresh CSRF/session/disabled-account/password checks after each asynchronous hash, and one transaction for credential update, all-session revocation, replacement session and completion receipt. No plaintext or fast password-derived idempotency digest is stored. Session handles grant no authentication and expose neither cookie nor database session hash. Current-session revocation uses logout. After a lost password-change response, bootstrap GET /session and query the completion receipt before claiming success; if the replacement cookie was lost, reauthenticate with the new password. A receipt never restores authentication. No email delivery or MFA is implied.
storageQuotaPolicy: Logical Evidence quotas include pending intents at creation, with committed storage rechecked at final submit. They bound 100 MiB/1000 versions per owner and 2 GiB/20000 versions per instance, and fail with STORAGE_FULL. They are not a physical disk quota for database history, backup directories or unrelated/orphan files. No submitted Evidence is automatically deleted.
paginationPolicy: Each page uses a short DEFERRED read snapshot that rechecks the server session, account status, role and target relationship before querying. Filters are applied before LIMIT. Cursors use bounded base64url JSON with a domain-separated HMAC, bound to actor UID, authorized target UID, resource and canonical filters; they expose no password verifier and grant no authentication. Unknown/repeated parameters, tampered cursors or changed scopes return INVALID_INPUT. Historical pages sort (immutable time DESC,id DESC), available times sort ASC. No OFFSET or full-dataset preload is used. Changes to reviews, statuses or search results are live, not a cross-request immutable snapshot: reset pagination after edits or filter changes. /workspace and /operations remain bounded overview summaries, not complete histories.
privateReadPolicy: Single Evidence records, unfinished-upload metadata, family access, operator overviews and account-security reads use the same short DEFERRED authorization snapshot as resource pages. Private files are authorized and integrity-checked before the download response starts; later permission revocation cannot recall bytes already sent. Every private download has an absolute thirty-second deadline.
learningGoalPolicy: Student-owned personal planning records, never verified school outcomes, AI assessment, grade or approval. Mutations recheck current session, role and CSRF under SQLite writer fence; parent reads require current enabled student and active recorded consent in the same read snapshot. Goal maximum100 across active/completed; no delete route. Full PATCH and Evidence link/unlink advance version exactlyonce for a new successful request, including no-op edits/duplicate links, with optimistic version checks and exact fingerprint receipts. Omitted optional steps preserve old-client data; [] explicitly clears and neither adding/completing/removing steps automatically completes the goal. Explicit link/unlink modifies only the association. Existing schema3 receipts are enriched with historically empty steps and count0 rather than mutable current state. New exact requestId retries return the originally committed DTO; changed bodies conflict. No browser token or data storage is needed.
workspaceUpdatesPolicy: Live derived feed, not email/push delivery or an audit ledger: persisted booking creation plus its current cancellation event (reschedule creates a replacement reservation and cancels the original); one published learning-record event; only latest persisted manual review perEvidence. Elapsed meeting periods add no event and never certify attendance. Earlier superseded review events disappear; new request to mark absent event returns404, while exact replay of earlier successful receipt returns its committed result. EventIDs are bound to student,source and persistedversion. Read-only parents see student read state; only student can mark. Count covers entire current stream, pages25. Read-all uses one writer transaction to mark the full current unread snapshot; idempotent replay doesnotmark events created later. Queries reject unknown/repeatedparams; cursors are bounded HMAC-signed and scoped to actor,owner,filter and credentials. Parent consent/session/role rechecked on every read; no staff arbitraryfeedaccess.
meetingPreparationPolicy: One private preparation record per existing appointment. Version0 is a read-only blank default, never an automatically inserted row. Saving requires student ownership of booking and optional goal, a future starts_at and reserved status rechecked under writer fence. Full optimistic version and operation fingerprint avoid overwrites/double submissions; exact historical receipts can be recovered after time/status changes but never authorize a new late write. Goal completion is not required and ready is only self-reported. Current linked parents may read historical preparation but cannot edit it; operators cannot arbitrarily read it. Rescheduling retains preparation on the cancelled original booking, newbooking starts blank, noauto-copy or delete. GET never expires booking or mutates records. No Zoom,attendance,assessment,payment orclinical data collection is implied.
reflectionDraftPolicy: One private owner-only reflection draft, separate from submitted Evidence and never included in parent,operator,workspace,progress orplan exports. Active students only; fresh session,password,disabled and role checks protect read snapshots and write fences, with CSRF and no query-owner override. Save andclear use optimistic version CAS. Clear stores an empty monotonic tombstone, preventing stale version0 or prior-version writes from resurrecting content. Idempotency operations persist only a hash of input and {version} metadata, never historical title/text. Matching retries return current content only while that confirmed version remains current; superseded retries return CONFLICT and require a fresh GET without reapplying old content. Text/spacing/CRLF are preserved. This is manual persistence, not automatic submission orfile/revision recovery. Clear removes current draft text; protected older SQLite snapshots/backups can still contain prior content and are subject to operational retention.
calendarPolicy: Staff-published classes and requests persist in the existing SQLite database. Online/In Person is validated against published modalities. One row per student/class prevents duplicates. Pending parent/payment and confirmed requests reserve capacity; excess requests join a FIFO waiting list. Cancellation or parent decline promotes available waitlisted students to pending_approval; promotion never bypasses parent approval or payment. Paid approvals remain pending_payment because no HubSpot verification is connected and no client confirmation endpoint exists. Parent decisions require current enabled roles, active recorded family consent, fresh session, CSRF, optimistic version, and idempotent metadata receipts. Staff withdrawal cancels active requests atomically. Calendar and discovery read these same rows. Existing test enrollments are retained and clearly marked. No attendance, academic credit, email, external meeting, ESA transfer, or production charge is implied.
admissionsPolicy: Local interest applications create no users. Expiring scoped HttpOnly capability access is limited to the fictional local evaluation application, never email ownership verification. Tina-purpose slots are writer-fenced and separate from student availability. Private PDF/text uploads are bounded hashed transactional SQLite BLOBs included in verified private database backups. Operator review requires a fresh trusted role and records audit metadata; interview must be recorded before approval. Only approved applications receive 48-hour one-use hash-stored invitations. Parent UUID creation, invite consumption and session rotation share one transaction. Existing accounts retain login; public uninvited registration is closed. Email and meeting delivery remain unavailable; no production or real minor document use is authorized. After parent enrollment, an authorized operator can grant a seven-day student setup bound to that signed-in parent and application. The parent explicitly confirms family access and chooses student credentials. No public bearer token, student fixture, automatic email, account merge or unapproved user creation is involved. Account and family link commit in the same transaction. Metadata-only receipts omit password material; exact retries verify the supplied secret against the existing salted user verifier and cannot reset credentials. One student per admitted application; additional children require separately approved applications.
classEvidencePolicy: Existing Evidence uploads accept either appointmentId, or classId with appointmentId empty. Class submission requires an authenticated student own confirmed enrollment and a class that has started, rechecked at final submit. Evidence and pending-upload DTOs expose optional classId; appointmentId is empty only for a class context. Existing file privacy, storage quotas, review, revisions and goal associations apply. This is learning Evidence, not verification of attendance or credit.
studentProvisioningPolicy: No user account is created by an interest form. Provisioning requires interview completion, Tina approval, one-use parent enrollment invitation, parent account creation and separate operator authorization. Setup is visible only through normal authenticated application access, expires after seven days, and cannot be claimed by another parent or staff choosing credentials. Session/role/expiry/version/unique email are rechecked after asynchronous scrypt. The transaction creates exactly one student user and recorded family link. A failed insert rolls back setup, user, link, audit and receipt. Successful confirmation contains student identifier/name/email, never passwords or password hashes.
